## 99designs Designer Portfolio & Stats Finder

A scraper for 99designs that finds designers in the public directory or opens exact designer profiles to extract structured per-designer records: identity and tier, join date, portfolio metadata and images, contest and one-to-one project statistics, client review ratings and counts, availability and online status in search results, published responsiveness score, listed languages and certifications, and basic profile text. Outputs a structured dataset of designer records with timestamps and record markers suitable for sourcing, vetting and analytics.

## Use cases

- Designer sourcing: shortlist designers by category, level and language and compare contest and repeat-client metrics.  
- Vendor vetting: open a known profile to inspect rating, availability and portfolio before engagement.  
- Market research: measure counts and portfolio depth across categories, industries or certifications and compare designer metrics.  
- Portfolio tracking: re-scrape saved designer lists to follow new designs, likes and review growth over time.

## Freelancermap Projects & Freelancer Profiles Scrape

Scrapes live IT project listings and freelancer profiles from freelancermap.com to produce structured project and freelancer records for search, enrichment and analysis. Supports targeted and broad searches by keyword, skill, category, country, city, contract type and workplace setup, or direct project/profile URLs; provides four operational modes: project search, freelancer search, project detail and freelancer profile detail. Outputs comprehensive project data (titles and descriptions, required skills, industry, contract and remote share, budget amounts and currency, start and duration details, workload and status flags, posting and expiry dates, reference/company/poster information, locations) and comprehensive freelancer data (published rate and currency, experience and seniority signals, skills and skills counts, spoken languages with proficiency levels, availability and availability percentage, travel preferences, certifications, project history, portfolio items, public recommendations, attachment file names, membership/freshness signals and avatar). Technically, the Actor fetches public JSON endpoints and pages over HTTP without credentials, slices queries across site facets (sort orders, contract/workplace buckets, categories, countries, industries, posting dates, languages, rate and availability thresholds), merges and de-duplicates facet slices to expand coverage beyond the anonymous first page, supports multiple queries per run and optional detail-page enrichment, and omits empty fields instead of emitting nulls.

## Use cases

- Recruiters and staffing agencies monitoring fresh freelance IT demand.  
- Sourcing shortlists of available freelancers by skill, language and rate.  
- Rate and skill benchmarking across European IT markets.  
- Lead generation from projects that disclose the hiring company and poster.

actors.readmeSummary:
## Hostelworld Property Ratings & Price Finder

Scrapes structured hostel and budget-accommodation data from Hostelworld to produce property-level and city-level records for search, comparison, and analysis. Operates in three modes: city search, direct property-page scraping, and a curated top-destinations listing. Supports date-aware pricing and availability by using check-in/check-out dates and guest count, and provides quality filters for minimum rating and maximum nightly price. For each property the Actor extracts metadata and source URLs, accommodation type, location details and GPS coordinates, overall rating and review count plus per-category rating breakdown (atmosphere, cleanliness, facilities, location, security, staff, value), nightly price with currency, amenities lists, room-type availability flags, distance-to-center, check-in/out times, descriptive text, property images, and a collection timestamp; fields missing on the source page are omitted from records. Data is read from public Hostelworld pages without requiring login.

## Use cases

- Budget travel planning: find highest-rated hostels in a city within a price ceiling  
- Travel app development: power hostel comparison or trip-planning features with structured hostel data  
- Price benchmarking: compare accommodation prices across destinations for specific travel dates  
- Content research: gather hostel data for travel guides or blog posts  
- Academic or market research: analyze hostel distribution, rating patterns, and pricing across cities

## New York Business Entity Search & Filing History

Search and extract structured records from the New York Department of State business-entity registry and its open-data publication. ## Onion Directory & Contact Metadata Scraper

A metadata-focused scraper that aggregates and normalizes onion-directory listings and index-result metadata for v3 .onion services. It merges records from multiple directory sources by onion domain while preserving provenance, applies neutral category tagging and short descriptions, extracts structured contact metadata (PGP fingerprint/key ID/contact email, mailto/tel links, explicit social profile links), and can measure site liveness using a bundled Tor daemon by performing controlled root-domain checks. The Actor also supports a search mode that returns index-result metadata (titles, URLs, ranks, snippets, last-seen claims) from Ahmia; outputs are oriented around directory entries and search-result metadata rather than page bodies.

## Use cases

- Aggregating and deduplicating OnionTree, dark.fail and tor.taxi directory listings by v3 onion domain for directory consolidation.
- Enriching threat-intelligence and OSINT pipelines with directory provenance, neutral category tags, short descriptions and structured contact metadata.
- Performing catalog or directory quality checks across multiple onion-directory sources.
- Conducting lawful security research and triage on onion-service listings without harvesting page content.
- Measuring service reachability and response conditions for onion domains via Tor-based liveness checks.
- Harvesting Ahmia search index metadata (titles, URLs, ranks, snippets, last-seen claims) for topical discovery and monitoring.

actors.readmeSummary:
## Udemy Course Catalog & Instructor Finder Scrape

A web-scraping Actor that extracts Udemy course catalog and instructor portfolio metadata for keyword search, category/topic browsing, targeted course-URL retrieval, or full instructor catalog pulls. It returns per-course metadata including pricing and discount details (numeric and currency), ratings and review/subscriber counts, course duration and content-length information, counts and types of curriculum items (sections, lectures, quizzes, practice tests, coding exercises, assignments), learning outcomes, requirements, target audiences, certificates and closed-caption availability (with languages), badges and date metadata, primary category/subcategory and locale/language, instructor metadata, and plain-text descriptions; it also emits instructor-profile records with profile info, course totals and social links followed by the instructor’s courses. The Actor supports rich buyer-style filters (level, free/paid, language, minimum rating, video-length ranges, presence of quizzes/practice tests/coding exercises/role-play/certification-prep, closed-caption language requirements), can paginate large catalogs (batch sizing with a per-slice cap), omits empty fields from records, and reads publicly available Udemy pages without signing in.

## Use cases

- Course market research: compare prices, discounts, ratings, and subscriber counts across categories  
- Curriculum benchmarking: compare section and lecture structures across competing courses  
- Instructor scouting: obtain a teacher’s full catalog and audience size for partnership evaluation  
- Deal monitoring: track list prices, sale prices, and discount percentages over time  
- Learning-path planning: shortlist courses by language, level, duration, and learning outcomes  
- Catalog enrichment: add Udemy course metadata, badges, captions, and curriculum structure to an existing catalog

actors.readmeSummary:
## Vimeo Channel, Creator & Video Metadata Extractor

A web scraping Actor that extracts structured metadata from public Vimeo content: videos, creators, channels, comments and likers. It supports multiple operational modes (channel lists, creator/user profiles, single-video details, Staff Picks, keyword search, creator search, channel search, category and tag browsing, showcases, video comments and video likers), advanced search filters (duration, 4K/resolution, price, Creative Commons license, upload date ranges, Staff Picks, HDR variants, 360/spatial, live status, category) and sort orders (relevance, date, popularity and alphabetical options). The Actor outputs dense, structured records for videos (identifiers, titles, descriptions, canonical and embed URLs, thumbnails, uploader identity and profile context, timestamps, duration, resolution/HD flag, view/like/comment counts, tags, language, license, content rating, privacy and embeddability/download/playability/audio flags, Vimeo badges such as Staff Pick/HDR/live/VOD, channel/context metadata and source URL), creator profiles (biography, avatar, counts, links, verification and account type), channel profiles (descriptions, assets, counts, tags/categories), comment threads (text, authorship, timestamps, reply totals) and liker profiles (user identity, profile links, location and join date). The Actor can optionally emit creator and channel profile records preceding their videos, deduplicates videos discovered across multiple sources, and can return large result sets (supports up to 10,000 records per source).

## Use cases

- Content curation: monitor Staff Picks, channels and categories for new films to feature
- Creator research: compare creator upload histories, follower counts and engagement metrics
- Brand and agency monitoring: discover brand films by keyword, category, license or upload date
- Audience analysis: extract commenters and likers for community and influencer research
- Metadata archiving: build structured catalogs of titles, tags, licenses, dates and badges
- Embed sourcing: collect player URLs and thumbnails for curated video collections
